content: better-sqlite3: enable WAL via db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL'); library defaults to synchronous=NORMAL in WAL (slight durability loss), override with pragma synchronous=FULL. When several processes/threads use the db, watch WAL file size and run pragma wal_checkpoint(RESTART) to avoid checkpoint starvation and unbounded WAL growth. Transactions across ATTACHed dbs are not atomic as a set. SQLite still allows only ONE writer at a time regardless of connections; set busy timeout via new Database(path,{timeout:5000}). API is fully synchronous so every query blocks the Node event loop - keep queries short/indexed and never do long scans on the request path.
